transcript.speaker: Husband
transcript.text: Let me think… I know you’re planning to go grocery shopping tomorrow, so that’s two one-way trips. Off the top of my head, I’d say we have 2 trips planned.

transcript.speaker: Husband

transcript.speaker: Wife
transcript.text: Exactly. I don’t think we’ve missed anything else, so 4 trips sounds right to me.

transcript.text: That makes sense. I was including the possibility of an extra errand, but since that isn’t certain yet, I’m fine counting only the trips we know will happen. 10 trips sounds reasonable.
